messages:
Hannah Liu: Quick follow-up on the compact inspector prototype I dropped. Opening a function preview currently pushes the run history and it's making side-by-side comparisons annoying. Thoughts?

Diego Morales: Saw it. The motion is nice but the layout shift steals context. Could we collapse to a single summary row that expands into a popover anchored to the row (no page reflow)?

Sam Bennett: Popover is good for preserving scroll, but it can interfere with keyboard copy/paste. Alternative: absolute-positioned panel anchored to the row that doesn't change flow, same visual as a popover but avoids focus traps unless in edit mode.

Lina Park: Copy nit: the label currently reads "Schema (auto-detect)" in some places and "Inferred schema" in others. My suggestion: "Schema preview — inferred". Also we should standardize the action verb to "Run" throughout.

Hannah Liu: Accessibility: screen readers announce "expanded" but not function context. We need aria-labels like: aria-label=\"Schema preview for function Summarize (expanded)\" and use a polite aria-live when state changes. Preview-expand should not steal focus. Edit-expand should move focus into the first input.

ProtoBot: Created issue #980: "compact-inspector-a11y". Acceptance: 1) verbose aria-labels for expand controls; 2) preview-expand leaves focus; 3) edit-expand focuses primary input; 4) aria-live polite announcement.

Diego Morales: Run history suggestion: show compact param chips inline (TXT/NUM/FILE) with 12-14px icons + 2-3 char label. They speed scanning. Chips must have aria-labels like "title: text" and be tabbable when a run entry is focused.

Sam Bennett: Dev note: chips should be semantic elements (role:listitem) and expose the full value on hover/tooltip. Also make sure contrast passes AA and provide a motion-reduced animation option.

Lina Park: Small UX poll: default collapsed (power users) or expanded (new users)? Reply :one: for collapsed, :two: for expanded.

Diego Morales: :one: (collapse)

Sam Bennett: :one: (collapse, auto-expand on first-run)

Hannah Liu: :two: (leaning to expand for discoverability)

ProtoBot: Poll recorded: 2 votes collapse, 1 expand. Suggested default: collapsed with a first-run auto-expand override.

Diego Morales: Keyboard shortcut consistency: bind `R` to Run in the playground and show tooltip "Press R to run" on the Run button. Put a reminder in the help overlay (Press ? for shortcuts).

Sam Bennett: Runtime caveat: collapsing result previews must not evict ephemeral KV cache required for replay. I'll open a runtime ticket and verify retention TTLs.

Lina Park: I'll make the copy PR to change labels to "Schema preview — inferred" and swap any inconsistent Run/Invoke/Execute verbs to "Run". Also add microcopy when auto-detect fails: "Schema couldn't be inferred. Edit to continue."

Hannah Liu: For the prototype I'll add two interactions: preview-expand (no focus change, subtle fade) and edit-expand (move focus, plain transition). I'll attach a short prototype link when ready.

ProtoBot: Linked TODOs to project board: [Hannah] prototype + figma link, [Lina] copy PR, [Sam] runtime KV ticket, [Diego] chip ARIA patterns + token sketches.

Hannah Liu: Thanks all. Quick checklist in thread: 1) anchored panel spec, 2) param chips accessible, 3) focus rules, 4) `R` shortcut, 5) copy updates. Will follow up with the prototype. :thumbsup:
